_comment: SMOKE TEST ONLY (scripts/smoke.sh). Never use on a real site: the policy below gives the admin role the treasurer's money permissions, so the smoke test can sign in with the admin password on a fresh instance, and session.secure is off because the test talks plain HTTP to localhost (a real site is behind HTTPS and keeps the secure default).

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: SMOKE TEST ONLY: admin keeps the ledger
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Lets scripts/smoke.sh exercise the ledger as the admin on a fresh instance. Remove on any real site.
